description: Open a deal against a listing (-> NEGOTIATING). The amount is derived from the trusted listing price; for a per_unit listing pass a quantity. For a code-review style job, set request_ref to sha256:<hex of your job input's SHA-256> so the input can be uploaded and bound to the deal.

quantity.description: units to purchase for a per_unit listing (positive integer >= 1); omit for a flat listing

request_ref.description: optional caller-side correlation reference for this negotiation

name: start_negotiation
